hero.heading: Join the club, support the sport.
hero.lede: There's no fee to join KERNO itself. Membership is administered by British Orienteering, and joining automatically makes you a member of the South West Orienteering Association (SWOA) too. From January 2026, only British Orienteering members are covered by public liability insurance at events.

whatYouGet.heading: Insurance, lower fees, ranking points, and a voice in the club.

benefits.title: British Orienteering insurance
benefits.body: Public liability insurance covers you at every BO-affiliated event. From January 2026, non-members are no longer covered, you take part at your own risk and are personally liable for accidents to others or property damage. Membership solves this.

benefits.title: Discounted entry
benefits.body: Members pay a few pounds less per event than non-members at most fixtures, including all KERNO events and most regional and national fixtures.

benefits.title: Ranking points
benefits.body: Your results count toward the British Orienteering ranking system and the regional SWOA league. You also become eligible for age-class trophies and the club's own awards.

benefits.title: Newsletter and events priority
benefits.body: Three or four newsletters a year with race reports, route reviews, and what's coming up. Members also get priority on capacity-limited events.

benefits.title: Training and coaching
benefits.body: Members-only training sessions on map-reading, pace judgement, route choice, and night orienteering. Coaching support for juniors aiming at JK, JEC and EYOC selection.

benefits.title: A voice in the club
benefits.body: Members can vote at the AGM, stand for committee, propose events, and shape what KERNO does next.

threeMemberships.heading: KERNO, SWOA and British Orienteering in one membership.
threeMemberships.body: There's no separate KERNO fee; you pay a single British Orienteering membership, which also covers the South West Orienteering Association. Approximate 2026 fees (joining part-way through the year, from 1 May) are: Senior 11 pounds, Young Adult (21-25) 7 pounds, Junior 3 pounds, and Family 26 pounds. Full-year rates are shown on the British Orienteering join form.
threeMemberships.note: The membership year runs to 31 December. Joining in November or December covers the following year. Most members renew automatically each January.

howToJoin.heading: Two minutes online.
steps: **Go to the British Orienteering join page.** Membership is administered there on KERNO's behalf.
**Choose Cornwall Orienteering Club (KERNO)** as your club, then pick your membership type (Senior, Young Adult, Junior or Family).
**Pay by card.** The membership year runs to 31 December; joining mid-year still covers you to year-end.
**You're in.** A confirmation email arrives within a few minutes, and you can come along to any event straight away.
howToJoin.contactNote: Questions about membership? Get in touch with the Membership Secretary, Steve Beech, via the [contacts page](/contacts).
